fix_summary: 仅将producer上报转换为既有dataset=sector_quote_facts及physical_rows_read字段，不扩展服务合同、不吞异常；复用bootstrap和增量测试，模拟慢分块并接入真实MonthlyReleaseService._stage_control，验证真实读数、月内读取和未知字段仍失败。三轮审核：根因/字段语义、增量与失败边界、设计符合性与交付范围。
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
root_cause: 共享行业报价producer把自身receipt字段source_rows_read和inherited_row_count直接用于严格月更stage progress回调；原测试投影耗时不到2秒且使用默认空回调，未触发正式服务的字段校验。BUILD270在已通过断点恢复、消费smoke与build validate后因此于打包阶段终止。

fresh_process_evidence: RED: two fresh-process targeted pytest cases wire the real quote-facts producer to MonthlyReleaseService._stage_control with elapsed chunk time above the 2-second threshold; both reproduce stage progress fields differ before the fix. GREEN: both pass after mapping to the existing physical_rows_read field; bootstrap reports exactly four read rows and incremental reports exactly one new-month row while retaining the prior fact. Unknown source_rows_read progress remains rejected.

Fresh AIstock pytest process executes production build_sector_quote_facts against real MonthlyReleaseService._stage_control for bootstrap and incremental chunks exceeding 2 seconds; RED two unsupported-field failures before fix, GREEN two passes after fix; unknown progress keys remain rejected, no database access or production candidate mutation.
